content: Only two sons are known by name: Jamāl al-Dīn Muḥammad, for whom Ibn Turka wrote his logic manual K. al-Manāhij, and Najīb al-Dīn Ḥabīb Allāh, who appears to have written a brief lettrist treatise, Qavāʿid-i Jafr-i Jāmiʿ (MS Bodleian 1298/48 ff. 284a-85b). Nothing more is known of Najīb al-Dīn.
